parts.changeReason: V1.16 rear converter box frame, layout F regenerated from build_f.py (back-plate/layout-F/README.md): the V1.11 frame with the two cap-screw ear bosses and their webs removed, the front passage P1 filled (solid front plate) and no tooth slots or hook notch (Shawn 2026-10-15: the cap is held by screws only). Shawn 2026-10-14: every box wire runs outside the box through the side windows or over the box top (the slot made assembly hard and left a seam between the boards), and the +y ear tail was ugly. Everything else is the V1.11 frame: cover outline, four cover holes and lip, wide and narrow tiers, side windows, USB-C slot, eight XL4015 bosses, four 5991 bosses, driver lanes. The two XL4015 bosses at z 38.7 and the two upper 5991 bosses now take the cap screws. Wire notch A, the top-wall front edge cut back from x -47.0 to -49.8 over y 3.2..12.4 (rear corners r 1.0), and notch B, the cover-plate top edge lowered from z 29.5 to 28.5 over the same band (floor corners r 0.5, cover lip untouched); the 7 V and 5 V pairs climb the outside of the +y wall, cross the box top, drop through notch A into the box front cavity and pass under the shell lip through notch B onto the cover lip into the pack. Volume 10292.8 mm3, watertight, one body (layout-F/checks.json, post_build.json).

parts.changeReason: V1.16 cap: the V1.11 rounded cap without its two screw ears, tongues or hook; it pushes straight on (Shawn 2026-10-15: "if a screw fits, use a screw"). Ray cast in layout-F/raycast_cap_screws.json. Nothing outside the box outline. Volume 6404.0 mm3, watertight, one body.
